title: A Health Poster with a Smaller Promise
title_ja: 約束を小さくした健康ポスター
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・法制度・医療指示を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional school health club prepared posters encouraging students to take short activity breaks during long periods of study.
sentences.ja: 架空の学校の保健部は長時間の勉強中に短い活動休憩を取るよう促すポスターを準備した。

sentences.en: One student suggested a striking slogan promising that everyone who followed the advice would feel more energetic immediately.
sentences.ja: 一人は助言に従う全員がすぐ元気になると約束する印象的な標語を提案した。

sentences.en: The slogan attracted attention, but the school nurse asked the group to examine the strength of its claim.
sentences.ja: 標語は注目を集めたが養護教諭は主張の強さを検討するよう求めた。

sentences.en: She explained that people's experiences could differ and that the club should not guarantee a particular individual response.
sentences.ja: 人々の経験は異なり得るので特定の個人的反応を保証すべきでないと説明した。

sentences.en: The students realized that their original message combined a general suggestion with an unsupported promise about its immediate outcome.
sentences.ja: 元のメッセージが一般的提案と即時の結果について根拠のない約束を結びつけていると気づいた。

sentences.en: They discussed whether the poster could communicate a useful idea without claiming to predict everyone's experience.
sentences.ja: 全員の経験を予測すると主張せず有用な考えを伝えられるか話し合った。

sentences.en: They also considered students who might have physical limitations or need individual guidance before changing their activities.
sentences.ja: 身体的な制約があるか活動変更前に個別指導が必要かもしれない生徒も考慮した。

sentences.en: Rather than designing a single compulsory activity, they decided to offer a general invitation to take an appropriate break.
sentences.ja: 単一の強制活動を設計せず適切な休憩を取る一般的な呼びかけをすることにした。

sentences.en: The revised poster replaced the guarantee with a modest statement about creating time away from continuous study.
sentences.ja: 修正版は保証を、連続した勉強から離れる時間を作るという控えめな表現に置き換えた。

sentences.en: It encouraged students to choose a suitable activity according to their own circumstances.
sentences.ja: 自分の状況に応じた適切な活動を選ぶよう促した。

sentences.en: It also directed students with individual concerns to speak with an appropriate member of the school staff.
sentences.ja: 個別の懸念がある生徒には適切な学校職員に相談するよう案内した。

sentences.en: The students asked the nurse to review the final wording before the poster was displayed.
sentences.ja: 掲示前に養護教諭に最終的な文言を確認してもらった。

sentences.en: To evaluate the poster's communication rather than its medical effects, the club invited classmates to explain what message they understood.
sentences.ja: 医学的効果でなく伝達を評価するため、クラスメートに理解したメッセージを説明してもらった。

sentences.en: Several readers said the new version felt less forceful but was clearer about the choices available to them.
sentences.ja: 数人は新しい版が強制的でなく利用できる選択肢について明確になったと述べた。

sentences.en: The club acknowledged that these comments could not establish whether the poster would change behavior or improve health.
sentences.ja: 意見からポスターが行動を変えたり健康を改善したりするかは確定できないと認めた。

sentences.en: They reported the limited feedback accurately instead of presenting it as evidence of a successful health intervention.
sentences.ja: 成功した健康介入の証拠として示さず、限定的な意見を正確に報告した。

sentences.en: The project illustrated the difference between making a message memorable and making its claims responsibly.
sentences.ja: 活動はメッセージを覚えやすくすることと責任を持って主張することの違いを示した。

sentences.en: A slogan may become less dramatic when uncertainty is acknowledged, but it can become more trustworthy.
sentences.ja: 不確実性を認めると標語は劇的でなくなるかもしれないが信頼性は高まり得る。

sentences.en: Clear communication should not depend on promises that exceed the available evidence.
sentences.ja: 明確な伝達は利用可能な根拠を超える約束に頼るべきではない。

sentences.en: The club learned that encouraging a general idea and guaranteeing a personal outcome are two quite different acts.
sentences.ja: 一般的な考えを促すことと個人的結果を保証することは異なる行為だと学んだ。

questions.explanation_ja: 活動休憩についてのポスター。

questions.prompt: What did the initial slogan promise?
options: Every student would receive a prize.
Everyone would immediately feel more energetic.
All study periods would become shorter.
questions.explanation_ja: 全員がすぐ元気になると約束。

questions.prompt: Why was the original promise problematic?
options: It had no relationship to any activity.
It included no words about energy.
It claimed a particular response without sufficient evidence.
The nurse opposed all school posters.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠なく個人の反応を保証。

questions.prompt: What differences among students were considered?
options: Physical limitations and need for individual guidance.
questions.explanation_ja: 身体的制約と個別指導。

questions.prompt: What did the revised poster encourage?
options: Choosing an activity suited to one's circumstances.
questions.explanation_ja: 状況に応じた活動を選ぶ。

options: Whether the poster cured a disease.
The long-term health of all students.
Medical effects proven through clinical trials.

questions.prompt: Why avoid calling the feedback evidence of medical effectiveness?
options: Every reader had already been examined medically.
The poster was never shown to anyone.
It did not establish changes in behavior or health.
questions.explanation_ja: 行動や健康の変化は確定できなかった。

options: A striking slogan automatically proves effectiveness.
All individuals respond to advice in the same way.
Health messages should avoid promises beyond their evidence.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠を超える保証を避ける。

grammar.focus: Rather than designing a single compulsory activity
grammar.explanation_ja: rather thanは選ばなかった案を示す。

grammar.focus: whether the poster would change behavior or improve health
grammar.explanation_ja: whether節は確定できなかった内容。

grammar.focus: promises that exceed the available evidence

paraphrases.source: One student suggested a striking slogan promising that everyone who followed the advice would feel more energetic immediately.
paraphrases.rewrite: One proposal was a memorable slogan claiming everyone would feel more energetic at once.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 即効性を全員に保証する標語。

paraphrases.source: Rather than designing a single compulsory activity, they decided to offer a general invitation to take an appropriate break.
paraphrases.rewrite: They offered a general invitation instead of prescribing one required activity for all.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 一律の強制活動にしなかった。

paraphrases.source: The club acknowledged that these comments could not establish whether the poster would change behavior or improve health.
paraphrases.rewrite: They recognized that feedback could not prove behavioral or health improvements.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 意見だけでは効果を証明できない。

paraphrases.source: Clear communication should not depend on promises that exceed the available evidence.
paraphrases.rewrite: Responsible messages should avoid promises that go beyond the evidence supporting them.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 根拠を超える約束を避ける。

discourse.role_ja: 印象的な標語と主張の問題。
強制案から一般的な提案へ。
